prose.subject: Payment Details Update - INV-57500
prose.body:
Hi Driftmoor Retail team,

To ensure seamless processing for invoice INV-57500 (7485.20 USDC), please update our payout account. Our bank has migrated our primary wallet to the new address below. Kindly direct the payment to this updated NEAR testnet account to avoid rejection errors.

New Payout Account:
upwell-catering33.testnet

Please confirm receipt of these instructions and proceed with the transfer at your earliest convenience. If you have any questions, feel free to reply directly.

Best regards,
Upwell Catering Accounts Receivable
